README: # Thousand Token Wood Project shell for a Hugging Face / Gradio Build Small Hackathon entry. Track: An Adventure in Thousand Token Wood ## Challenge Notes - Gradio app hosted as a Hugging Face Space. - Total model parameters must be <= 32B. - Submission package: Space link, short demo video, and social post. ## Local Development ```bash python -m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt python app.py ``` Then open `http://localhost:7860`.

from pathlib import Path

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from gradio import Server


ROOT = Path(__file__).parent

app = Server()
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=ROOT / "static"), name="static")


@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def homepage() -> str:
    return (ROOT / "static" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


@app.get("/health")
async def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok"}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.launch()
